cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - GridfinityBase
cc:Work.dc:description: A parameterized Gridfinity base This is a configurable gridfinity base. This design is based on Zach Freedman's Gridfinity system Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes GridfinityBase --x 2 --y 2 --size_x 100 --size_y 95 --base_type refined --bottom_edge h --Lid_style flat --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes GridfinityBase --x --size_x --size_y --base_type --bottom_edge --Lid_style --reference --labels
